newsitem.title: JAPAN: Meiji Life to invest 300 bln yen in foreign bonds.
newsitem.headline: Meiji Life to invest 300 bln yen in foreign bonds.

text.p: Meiji Life Insurance Co plans 300 billion yen worth of new investment in foreign bonds in the second half of the current fiscal year, a company official told reporters on Wednesday.
The official also said the company plans 70 billion yen worth of new investment in domestic bonds in the same period.
Because of stabilising foreign exchange rates, Meiji is planning to make new foreign bond investments in the second half of the current fiscal year, the official said.
He added the foreign bond investments will be mainly in short- and medium-term bonds.
